subject: LedgerLine pricing CTA — coordinate demo slot and budget details
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex@ledgerline.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-09T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interested via pricing CTA — request demo + budget context

Hi Ben / Hannah,

I filled out the pricing call-to-action on your site and wanted to follow up directly. I lead product at LedgerLine (payments orchestration for mid-market retailers). We have committed budget for an inference pilot and want to understand per-token economics, routing options, and the Dedicated vs Hosted tradeoffs.

Quick context: 30M annual transactions, primary use cases are checkout recommendations and customer support summarization. We're evaluating a proof-of-concept for Q4 and want a 30–45m demo focused on cost/latency and integration patterns.

Availability: I can do Mon 8/11 between 10:00–13:00 PDT or Tue 8/12 after 14:00 PDT. Prefer a short call with a demo and pricing rundown.

Account created via self-serve sign-up earlier today (Account ID: LDG-acct-7742). If you need any procurement docs up front, I can share — I also attached a brief one-pager about our stack (attached to my reply).

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Product, LedgerLine
alex@ledgerline.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@ledgerline.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-09T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested via pricing CTA — request demo + budget context

Hi Alex — great to meet you over email and congrats on signing up. I'm Ben on the Solutions team; thanks for the clear context.

Quick proposal: 30-minute demo that covers: 1) latency/cost profiles for your transaction volume, 2) Dedicated vs Hosted routing, and 3) integration patterns (SDK + event routing). I attached a short pricing summary and a mutual action plan template so we can map approvals.

Proposed slots (30m):
- Mon 8/11 10:30 PDT / 13:30 EDT
- Mon 8/11 11:30 PDT / 14:30 EDT
- Tue 8/12 15:00 PDT / 18:00 EDT

If none of those work, tell me the best day/time and timezone and I’ll move things around. Recording is fine if you want a copy. I’ll invite our latency lead if we need deeper kernel/quantization discussion — copying Hannah in case you want to bring your procurement/infra contact.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-summary.pdf, mutual-action-plan-template.docx

Best,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Agenda (30m):
- 5m intros + account context
- 10m demo (latency/cost highlights)
- 10m integration & roadmap fit
